Definition: properly, a deep round vessel, i.e. (specifically) a cor or measure for things dry
BiblicalUsage: 1) kor, a measure (usually dry); 1a) a dry or liquid measure equal to 10 ephahs or baths; 1a1) a dry measure containing 6.25 bushels (220 l); 1a2) a liquid measure of 58 gallons (263 l)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
